EBI's Proteins API and RefSeq (NP_004618.2, isoform 1) both give GET1 as **174 aa**, matching the actual sequence string (whose md5 checksum matches UniProt's own recorded md5). The "218 AA / 24725 MW" in UniProt's header/SQ line is inconsistent with the sequence it ships.

**Results**

| Gene | UniProt | Sequence length | Mass (computed from sequence) |
|---|---|---|---|
| RCVRN (Recoverin) | P35243 | 200 aa | 23,130 Da = **23.13 kDa** |
| GET1 (WRB) | O00258 | 174 aa | 19,779 Da = **19.78 kDa** |

RCVRN (recoverin) is heavier — by ~3.35 kDa. Note that the naive comparison using UniProt's stated GET1 metadata (24,725 Da) would have flipped the answer, so the sequence-based mass was used after confirming the 174-aa sequence three independent ways.
